name: Spicy Bacon, Eggplant & Mushroom Pasta (Amatriciana) with Parsley

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g penne pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggplants
⅓ kg white mushrooms
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice eggplants; quarter mushrooms. Transfer both to a large bowl and set aside.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add the bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 6-7 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer bacon to a paper towel-lined plate, leaving the drippings in the pot.
While the bacon cooks, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince onion and garlic.

Return the pot (with bacon drippings) to medium heat. Once the pot is hot, add eggplant, mushrooms, onion, garlic, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until eggplant and mushrooms are soft and golden, 10-12 minutes.
When the pasta is done, drain in a colander and return to the pot; cover and set aside.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are done, add tomato sauce and spices to pot. Stir to combine the veggie sauce and bring to a simmer; cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add veggie sauce, bacon, and half of the parsley (reserving the rest for garnish) to the pot with the pasta; stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls; top with reserved parsley, additional crushed red pepper, and Parmesan. Enjoy!
